limitations: Only captured observation prices are available; maximum drawdown excludes unobserved prices.
Exposure average is the arithmetic mean of captured samples, not a time-weighted average. Stale values remain explicitly flagged.
Hypothetical fills and slippage are unverified execution assumptions. No real orders were sent.
Comparisons share initial capital and the fee-rate version, but position limits (model up to3, single ETF1, equal-weight ETF6), turnover, paid fees and risk exposure differ; never merge accounts.
Twenty-session accuracy remains null; engineering completion or cash zero is not forecasting success.
Known historical exploration is not new blind or forward evidence. News is not a prediction input.
The latest incomplete JSONL tail is excluded and identified; a later report may have a different cutoff.
